item.title: Nigerian army rescues 31 held after Easter church attack
item.summary: Five civilians were killed by the gunmen and their bodies were recovered at the scene, the army said.

item.title: How rescue of US airman in remote part of Iran unfolded
item.summary: The operation to extract him from the ground in hostile territory was hugely complex and involved multiple US government agencies.

item.title: Trump declares victory after rescue but threats to US operation in Iran still loom
item.summary: The rescue could impact how Trump views a ground operation to take Kharg Island or to seize enriched uranium sites.

item.title: Hungary alleges plot to blow up gas pipeline ahead of election
item.summary: It comes a week before votes are cast and follows warnings of so-called false flag operations blamed on Ukraine.

item.title: German males under 45 may need military approval for long stays abroad
item.summary: Under the law, travel approvals must generally be granted and it remains unclear how the rule would be enforced if breached.

item.title: US Secret Service investigates reports of gunfire near White House
item.summary: Officials said "a heightened security posture is in place", but no injuries were reported and no suspects had been identified.

item.title: The 40 minutes when the Artemis crew loses contact with the Earth
item.summary: As the astronauts pass behind the Moon they will experience a moment of silence and solitude as communication with the Earth is blocked.

item.title: Emergency jabs after 100 children die of suspected measles in a month in Bangladesh
item.summary: More than 100 people, mostly children, have been killed by measles since mid-March, officials suspect.

item.title: Young gray whale dies after swimming up river in Washington state
item.summary: Hunger is a likely reason the whale, dubbed Willapa Willy, travelled inland, experts say.

item.title: DR Congo agrees to take deportees from the US
item.summary: The country will start receiving deportees from this month but has not said how many they will accept.
